limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.

applicability.scope: Find source-derived prior cases for an already classified Ascend inference bottleneck, including fallback, memory traffic, exposed communication, graph startup and host scheduling gaps.
applicability.prerequisites: A bottleneck classification from profiling and a check of the selected case preconditions/mechanism before applying it.
applicability.input_contract: Bottleneck symptoms and matching profiler evidence, model/hardware/CANN/configuration context and, for a new case, measured before/after metrics.
applicability.produced_artifact: A matching prior-art case and evidence requirements for a later measured application; a new case record requires a verified win or clear failure with a metric comparison.
applicability.refusal_point: Do not add an INCONCLUSIVE case or one without a measured metric comparison; a subjective direction is insufficient evidence.

recommendations: Classify first, then check the matching case preconditions and use its owning procedure to apply and measure the candidate; the casebook itself does not perform profiling.
Keep profiler mechanism evidence and same-window end-to-end outcomes together, and retain locally_verified=false until the applied case has actually run.
